Copied byte-for-byte from the author-created Autodesk Fusion native document.
The source author supplies screenshots but no independent STEP/STL exports.
This is a negative placement-fidelity fixture. The document contains
three native bodies but active Assemble and GeometricRelationship operations
remain native-only, with no qualified neutral placement definition. Native
geometry rendering must refuse it instead of assuming the local B-rep body
coordinates are the final assembly placements. The saved preview remains
available through the ordinary thumbnail path.
